
```{r}
library(dplyr)

BrewIndividualComposition <- setRefClass(
  #===== NAME =====#
  "BrewIndividualComposition",
  
  #===== ATTRIBUTES =====#
  fields = list(enc.dict = "list",
                features.pdf = "data.frame", 
                expanded.pdf = "data.frame", 
                num.features = "list"),
  
  #===== METHODS =====#
  methods = list(
    
    #----- initialize -----#
    initialize = function(mydict) {
      # assign encoding dictionary
      enc.dict <<- mydict
      
      # assign features distributions
      features.pdf <<- data.frame()
      expanded <<- data.frame()
      
      # assign number of features
      num.features <<- lapply(enc.dict, function(x) 0)
      
      for (col in names(enc.dict)) {
        # FIXME : lack of generality
        # One could just provide the list of features to include instead
        # this would still be a vector w/o attributes
        if (is.vector(enc.dict[[col]])) {
          if (is.null(attributes(enc.dict[[col]]))) {
            num.features[[col]] <<- length(enc.dict[[col]])
            
          } else {
            num.features[[col]] <<- length(enc.dict[[col]])
          }
          
        } else {
          stop("The encoding dictionary must contains only vectors.")
        }
      }
      
      # internal consistency check
      if (.internal.check()) {
        stop("Internal inconsistency, check your encoding dictionary.")
      }
    },
    
    #----- encode -----#
    encode = function(df) {
      output <- rep(0, nrow(df))
      
      # encode features for each provided column
      multiplier <- 1
      for (i in seq_along(names(enc.dict))) {
        if (i > 1) {
          multiplier <- multiplier * num.features[[i - 1]]
        }
        
        thisenc <- enc.dict[[i]]
        x <- df[[names(enc.dict)[i]]]
        
        if (is.null(attributes(thisenc))) {
          feats <- findInterval(x, thisenc)
        }
        else {
          feats <- as.integer(factor(x, levels = names(thisenc)))
          feats[is.na(feats)] <- length(thisenc)
        }
        
        output <- output + (feats - 1) * multiplier
      }
      
      return(output)
    },
    
    #----- decode -----#
    decode = function(feats) {
      output <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(enc.dict), 
                                     nrow = length(feats)))
      colnames(output) <- names(enc.dict)
      
      for (col in colnames(output)) {
        thisenc <- enc.dict[[col]]
        
        if (is.null(attributes(thisenc))) {
          output[[col]] <- thisenc[feats %% num.features[[col]] + 1]
        } else {
          aux_dict <- setNames(names(thisenc), thisenc)
          output[[col]] <- sapply(feats %% num.features[[col]], function(x)
            aux_dict[[as.character(x)]])
        }
        
        feats <- floor(feats / num.features[[col]])
      }
      
      return(output)
    },
    
    #----- FIXME : developer internal check -----#
    .internal.check = function() {
      aux <- lapply(enc.dict, function(v)
        if (is.vector(v))
          v[-length(v)]
        else
          names(v))
      input <- expand.grid(aux)
      colnames(input) <- names(enc.dict)
      output <- decode(encode(input))
      
      return(all(output == input))
    },
    
    #----- compute marginals -----#
    compute.marginals = function(database) {
      
      feats <- database %>%
        mutate(feature = encode(.))
        
      # update feature pdf
      features.pdf <<- feats %>%
        group_by(feature) %>%
        tally() %>%
        mutate(freqs = n / sum(n)) %>%
        select(!n)
        
      # update expanded pdf
      myvec <- c("feature", attributes(enc.dict)$names)
      expanded.pdf <<- feats %>%
        group_by(across(all_of(myvec))) %>%
        tally() %>%
        mutate(freqs = n / sum(n)) %>%
        select(!n)
    }
  )
)

#==== TESTING ====#

# Load database
database <- read.csv("database.csv")

# FIXME : temporary for testing
database$sex <- ifelse(database$sex==1, "F", "M")

# model according to group.classes
group.classes <- list(sex = c(M = 0, F = 1),
                      age = c(0, 10, 20, 40, 60))
bc <- BrewIndividualComposition$new(group.classes)
bc$decode(bc$encode(database)[1:10])

bc$compute.marginals(database)
```

```{r}
BrewHouseholdComposition  <- setRefClass(
  #===== NAME =====#
  "BrewHouseholdComposition",
  
  #==== INHERITANCE =====#
  contains = "BrewIndividualComposition",
  
  
  #===== ATTRIBUTES =====#
  fields = list(joint.pdf = "data.frame",
                hh.size.pdf = "data.frame",
                other.pdf = "data.frame"), 
  
  #===== METHODS =====#
  methods = list(
    
    #----- initialize -----#
    initialize = function(enc.dict) {
      callSuper(enc.dict)
      
      # default marginals
      joint.pdf <<- data.frame()
      hh.size.pdf <<- data.frame()
      other.pdf <<- data.frame()
    },
    
    #----- compute.marginals -----#
    compute.marginals = function(database,
                                 sortby = "features",
                                 ascending = FALSE) {
      
      # extract household size
      df <- database %>%
        group_by(house_index) %>%
        mutate(hh.size = n()) %>%
        ungroup()
      
      # add a column with encoded features
      df$features <- encode(df)
      
      # list with all model features
      model.features <- seq(prod(unlist(num.features))) - 1
      
      # frequencies list
      freqs <- list()
      
      # all pairs of house members ordered by feature
      # note : pair (X, X) are appended manually
      combinations <- c(
        utils::combn(model.features, 2, simplify = FALSE),
        lapply(model.features, function(x)
          c(x, x))
      )
      
      # joint compositions of the two `main` house members
      joint.tuple <- data.frame(hh.mem.a = sapply(combinations, `[`, 1),
                                hh.mem.b = sapply(combinations, `[`, 2))
      joint.tuple <- joint.tuple %>%
        arrange(hh.mem.a, hh.mem.b)
      
      # initialize joint freqs
      freqs$joint <- joint.tuple %>%
        mutate(freqs = 0)
      
      # size : initialize household conditioned sizes
      freqs$hh.size <- joint.tuple
      for (i in seq(2, max(df$hh.size))) {
        freqs$hh.size[[as.character(i)]] <- 0
      }
      
      # other : initialize conditioned compositions of other members
      freqs$other <- joint.tuple
      for (i in model.features) {
        freqs$other[[as.character(i)]] <- 0
      }
      
      # count for household wiith at least 2 members
      for (h in unique(df[df$hh.size > 1, ][["house_index"]])) {
        this.house <- df %>%
          filter(house_index == h)
        
        # sort by the two `main` household members
        if (ascending == TRUE) {
          this.house <- this.house %>%
            arrange_at(sortby)
          # extract the features of the two `main` house members
          x_1 <- this.house$features[1]
          x_2 <- this.house$features[2]
        } else {
          this.house <- this.house %>%
            arrange_at(sortby, desc)
          # extract the features of the two `main` house members
          x_1 <- this.house$features[2]
          x_2 <- this.house$features[1]
        }
        
        jmask <- which(joint.tuple$hh.mem.a == x_1 &
                         joint.tuple$hh.mem.b == x_2)
        
        # count `main` pair
        freqs$joint[jmask, "freqs"] <- freqs$joint[jmask, "freqs"] + 1
        
        # count sizes
        size <- this.house$hh.size[1]
        csize <- as.character(size)
        freqs$hh.size[jmask, csize] <- freqs$hh.size[jmask, csize] + 1
        
        # count other members
        if (size > 2) {
          for (i in seq(3, size)) {
            cfeat <- as.character(this.house$features[i])
            freqs$other[jmask, cfeat] <- freqs$other[jmask, cfeat] + 1
          }
        }
        
      }
      
      # normalize joint
      freqs$joint$freqs <- freqs$joint$freqs / sum(freqs$joint$freqs)
      
      # select size count columns
      scols <- 3:length(colnames(freqs$hh.size))
      
      # select other count columns
      ocols <- 3:length(colnames(freqs$other))
      
      # normalize hh.size and other
      for (i in seq(nrow(freqs$joint))) {
        norm <- max(1, sum(freqs$other[i, ocols]))
        freqs$other[i, ocols] <- freqs$other[i, ocols] / norm
        
        norm <- max(1, sum(freqs$hh.size[i, scols]))
        freqs$hh.size[i, scols] <- freqs$hh.size[i, scols] / norm
      }
      
      # assign marginals
      joint.pdf <<- freqs$joint
      other.pdf <<- freqs$other
      hh.size.pdf <<- freqs$hh.size
    },
    
    #----- generate households -----#
    generate.households = function(num_househ) {
      
      idx <- sample(seq(nrow(joint.pdf)), 
                        num_househ, 
                        replace = TRUE, 
                        prob = joint.pdf$freqs)
      
      scols <- 3:length(hh.size.pdf)
      sizelist <- as.integer(colnames(hh.size.pdf[scols]))
      ocols <- 3:length(other.pdf)
      otherlist <- as.integer(colnames(other.pdf[ocols]))
      
      # initialize encoded dataframe
      df <- data.frame()
        
      for (h in seq_len(num_househ)) {
        
        # add `main` pair
        df <- rbind(df, 
                    data.frame(features=joint.pdf[idx[h], 1], house_index=h))
        df <- rbind(df, 
            data.frame(features=joint.pdf[idx[h], 2], house_index=h))
        
        # sample house size
        jmask <- which(joint.pdf$hh.mem.a == joint.pdf[idx[h], 1] &
                         joint.pdf$hh.mem.b == joint.pdf[idx[h], 2])
        size <- sample(sizelist, 1, prob = hh.size.pdf[jmask, scols])
        
        # sample other members if any
        if (size > 2) {
          for (i in seq_len(size - 2)) {
            y <- sample(otherlist, 1, prob = other.pdf[jmask, ocols])
            df <- rbind(df, data.frame(features=y, house_index=h))
          }
        }
      }
      
      
      output <- cbind(data.frame(index = seq(nrow(df)),
                                 house_index = df$house_index),
                      decode(df$features))

      return(output)
    }
  )
)
```

```{r}
#==== TESTING ====#

# Load database
database <- read.csv("database.csv")

# FIXME : temporary for testing
database$sex <- ifelse(database$sex==1, "F", "M")

# model according to group.classes
age.max <- ceiling(max(database$age))
group.classes <- list(sex = c(F = 0, M = 1),
                      age = c(0, 10, 20, 40, 60, age.max))
bc <- BrewHouseholdComposition$new(group.classes)
bc$compute.marginals(database)

# sample 5 household from model
set.seed(291)
bc$generate.households(5)
```
